name: Context announcements
responsibility: Tells a tab session's coordinator and live voice a context change the host announces, each through the tab's one callback queue, and only while voice is live
description: With no voice session the receipt says voice_inactive and nothing is queued. Each audience the change names is its own callback, so the coordinator and the voice are told independently, in no fixed order.

outgoing.label: the coordinator's and the voice's parts of a change
outgoing.description: The voice agent's announce gives each audience a change names its own callback on the tab's queue, while voice is live.

outgoing.label: the execution context's keys, which a payload cannot use
